mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, '-') AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}
SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VAL, '-') AS TEMP FROM TEMP_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND TEMP_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY TEMP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(MAX_VAL, '-') AS TEMP_MAX, IFNULL(MIN_VAL, '-') AS TEMP_MIN FROM TEMP_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND TEMP_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VEL1, '-') AS WIND_VEL, IFNULL(AVR_DEG1, '-') AS WIND_DEG FROM WIND_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND WIND_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY WIND_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VAL, '-') AS HUMI FROM HUMI_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND HUMI_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY HUMI_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(MAX_VAL, '-') AS HUMI_MAX, IFNULL(MIN_VAL, '-') AS HUMI_MIN FROM HUMI_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND HUMI_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}
